items.description:
OBC Group is the head office, in Louwlardia, Centurion, of OBC Better Butchery, a South African retail brand trading since 1987 under the strapline Quality & Affordability. The company describes itself as one of South Africa's fastest-growing retail brands, with a mission to support the low to mid-market sector by offering quality, affordability and convenience across its stores, which include departments for butchery, liquor and bakery.

Its Blockman's Den content teaches customers about different cuts of meat, from beef to pork and lamb, alongside fresh meat from the in-store deli, a wide variety of frozen meat and vegetables for bulk or single-night buying, groceries, and, at many stores, a farm-fresh fruit and vegetable section. The group also operates an OBC Liquor division and takes franchisee applications from people wanting to join the brand. It suits shoppers looking for affordable meat, liquor and groceries from a South African-grown retail chain, and prospective franchisees exploring the brand.

items.description:
Ons Winkel Sinoville is one of around 130 Ons Winkel donation stores run nationwide by Solidariteit Helpende Hand (Solidarity Helping Hand). Members of the public can donate good-quality second-hand goods such as furniture, kitchenware, linen, clothing, sports equipment and toys, which the store then sells to the public at affordable prices.

The organisation says this model creates sustainable businesses and job opportunities while supporting Solidarity Helping Hand's broader community-based social development goals, which include initiatives for children and youth, food relief, dental care for children, school bags and support for animals. The Ons Winkel network describes itself as growing strongly across South Africa. It suits bargain hunters looking for affordable second-hand household goods in Sinoville, as well as people wanting to donate items to a cause with a clear social purpose.

OnTime Readymix Concrete's Centurion plant, on Kruger Avenue in Lyttelton Manor, is part of a minority-owned readymix concrete business established around 20 years ago to supply quality-guaranteed concrete at competitive rates. The company's product range covers standard readymix concrete, pump mix concrete, pool mix concrete, colour concrete, polypropylene micro fibre reinforcement, mortars, and the supply of concrete pumps for a project.

The OnTime Readymix management group draws on seven decades of combined industry experience, and the company positions itself as a fully compliant BEE business contributing to the country's transforming economy. Its strapline, reliable, durable, delivered on time, every time, reflects its focus on dependable supply for building projects. It suits builders, contractors and homeowners in the Centurion area who need readymix concrete, concrete pumping or mortar supplied directly to site.

ORD Holdings operates from Hazeldean Office Park in Pretoria, the same address used by ORD Financial Services, an insurance brokerage offering both short-term and long-term cover. Its short-term insurance protects the things clients rely on daily, including vehicles, home contents, portable possessions, buildings and business assets, while its long-term insurance plans help protect income, family and future plans.

The brokerage describes its approach as independent, client-focused advice with clear explanations and no unnecessary jargon, backed by years of combined experience among its advisers. Cover is tailored to each client's needs, risks and budget, with responsive support available by phone, email and WhatsApp, built on what the firm describes as a personal approach rooted in trust and long-term relationships. It suits individuals, families and businesses in Pretoria looking for practical, personally advised insurance cover.

items.description:
OTT Technologies is a manufacturer of armoured and mine-protected vehicles based in Mooiplaats, Pretoria, with a product line that includes mine-protected vehicles such as the Puma M36 and Puma M26, security vehicles including the Bulldog M34 and Protector M21, the Gladiator M40 armoured Land Cruiser, and the Centurion M42 bulk carrier.

The company's corporate profile covers its manufacturing track record, its manufacturing facility, ISO certification, and in-house engineering capability, reflecting a focus on certified protection built into each vehicle it produces. Its vehicle range serves applications described on its site as security, personnel carrying, police use, riot control, cash-in-transit and mine or blast protection. It suits government, security and commercial clients across Africa and beyond who need armoured or mine-protected vehicles engineered and certified in South Africa.

PayDay Software Systems is a payroll and human resources software company based in Murrayfield, Pretoria, that has built payroll solutions since 1989. Its product range includes PayDay Payroll Software and Human Capital Software, PayDay Virtual for online payroll and human capital management, PayDay Visible for time and attendance tracking, and PayDay Visual for employee self-service.

The company also runs PayDay Training, offering payroll software courses, human capital training courses, other training courses, and seminars and system lectures for its users. It describes itself as a leading provider used by small to large businesses, accountants and municipalities, built on a client-oriented, user-empowerment approach, with trust among its staff, clients, business partners and investors cited as the basis of its success. It suits businesses, accounting firms and municipalities that need payroll, time and attendance or HR software with training support included.

Perfect Laser Technologies Pretoria trades from Montana Value Centre in Montana Park, as the Pretoria branch of a national supplier of laser and fibre cutting and engraving machines. Its product range covers fibre laser cutters able to slice through stainless steel, mild steel, aluminium and other metals, CNC routers with accessibly priced bits, CO2 laser cutting and engraving machines ranging from 300mm by 400mm up to 2 by 3 metres and from 40 to over 300 watts of power, and colour machines using eco-solvent, UV or food-safe printing.

The company says it writes its own technical manuals for its machines and runs Saturday morning training sessions for customers, which points to an emphasis on after-sales support rather than just equipment sales. It also publishes product tips and advice through its media channels. It suits businesses and entrepreneurs in Pretoria looking to start or grow a laser cutting, engraving or CNC routing operation with equipment and training from one local supplier.

items.description:
Pharma Valu Sunnyside is a branch of the Pharma Valu pharmacy group, trading from Robert Sobukwe Street in Sunnyside. The store is wheelchair accessible and accepts card payments, and it offers same-day delivery for customers who cannot collect their order in person.

Alongside its pharmacy counter, the branch runs an in-store photo-lab service, where customers can print photos directly from a camera, memory stick, CD or cellphone. The branch keeps extended hours, open Monday to Friday from 8am to 8pm and on both Saturday and Sunday from 9am to 5pm. It suits Sunnyside residents who want a pharmacy with evening and weekend hours, along with the convenience of photo printing in the same visit.

Pienaar Bros is a personal protection and safety equipment supplier based in Hennopspark, Centurion, that has been trading for more than 50 years and is today one of the largest distributors of PPE in Southern Africa, serving around 3,000 customers. Its product ranges cover respiratory protection including dust masks and half-face masks, hearing protection such as earmuffs, head protection including helmets, general workwear and welding wear, along with eyewear, boots and gloves fitted to different applications.

The company also supplies arc flash protection from Zeroflame acid garments and chemical protection using Tyvek and Tychem disposable suits by Dupont. Its products are available through an online store as well as direct enquiry, with staff available to help customers find the right safety gear for their environment. It suits businesses and workers across Southern Africa who need PPE supplied by an established, large-scale distributor.

Planet Fitness Queenswood is a gym on the corner of Stead Avenue and Whittle Lane in Queenswood, built around a cardio deck, a free weights area, a functional training area and a dedicated abdominal section. The club's page lists change rooms, a disabled lift for accessible entry, free Wi-Fi and free parking among its facilities for members.

Membership includes access to a class schedule and the chain's wider community features, including its Hybrid Games events, alongside the option to find and use other Planet Fitness clubs. The gym markets itself around flexible membership options that fit different training routines and budgets. It suits Queenswood residents who want a modern, well-equipped gym with group classes and strength and cardio equipment close to home.

Polecat Tamper Proof Gate Motors, based in Zwavelpoort, manufactures a patented, all-steel gate motor built directly into the gate's own frame rather than bolted onto a pole where it can be removed. The motor is welded top and bottom into the gate's upright steel structure, with its electronics locked more than 300mm above ground inside a Faraday-cage steel frame that diverts lightning-induced electrical interference away from the components.

The range includes the Polecat 24V and 12V Tamper Proof Gate Motors, an MPPT solar controller, a LiFePo4 15Ah battery, a GSM module and an extra receiver, with two on-board buttons handling basic setup from start to finish and a downloadable installation schematic and technical data sheet available at any time. The company holds South African patent number 2023/11222 for the design, which it developed specifically to counter gate motor theft, an epidemic it says affects properties across Gauteng. It suits homeowners, estates and installers who want a gate motor that cannot be levered off, unbolted or cut free in the way standard units can.

PostNet Equestria trades from Shop 11A at Equestria Centre, on the corner of Simon Vermooten and Furrow Road. The branch's online shop lists A4 and A3 printing, wide-format and plan printing, business cards, photo printing, name badges, rubber stamps, stationery, packaging material, courier services and Vox website services, covering copying, printing and digital business needs under one roof.

The branch is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5:30pm and Saturday from 8:30am to 2pm, and it is closed on Sundays and public holidays. Customers can register and trade through its online shop as well as in person. It suits residents and businesses around Equestria and Die Wilgers who need courier, printing or stationery handled at a single local store.

PostNet Gezina Galleries trades from Shop 32 inside the Gezina Galleries centre on Frederika Street. The branch is classified under print shop, copy shop, courier service, digital printing service and mailing service, reflecting the range of courier, copying, printing and stationery work handled at this store.

The branch keeps longer hours than many PostNet stores, open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5:30pm, Saturday from 8am to 2pm, and Sunday from 9am to 1pm, which means it is also available over the weekend and on Sundays for customers who cannot get there during the working week. It suits Gezina shoppers and small businesses who need courier, printing or digital business services on a day when many other stores are closed.

items.description:
Practice Perfect Medical Software, based at Boardwalk Office Park in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, develops electronic health record and practice management software aimed at making patient health record management easier, faster and more efficient for South African medical professionals. Key features include patient self-registration, where patients capture their own details and complete a practice's consent form independently, and the capture of medical history covering allergies, medical conditions, surgical history, medication, and social and family history.

The software also generates an appointment diary with SMS reminders and confirmation replies, and lets practitioners create consultation notes using standard or custom templates, dictation, or AI Intelli-scribe, with a newly available Heidi Scribe integration that pushes AI-generated notes directly into a patient's file to cut down on copy and paste work. Optional integrations include Mims for drug information and Discovery HealthID, along with eScript prescriptions sent to leading pharmacies. It suits general practitioners, surgeons and other medical professionals who want patient records, scheduling and prescriptions handled in one system.

Pretor Group is a property management company based at River Falls Office Park in Doringkloof, Pretoria, with 50 years in business. Its commercial division manages more than 60,000 square metres of retail, office and warehouse space, keeping financial records on MRI, providing on-site supervision and ensuring compliance matters are in place for office blocks, retail, warehouses and industrial properties.

On the residential side, the group manages more than 22,000 homes in estates, with skilled handling of homeowners' associations, compliance with legislative requirements and real-time financial reporting, alongside more than 35,500 sectional title homes supported by dedicated portfolio managers and a 24/7 online client portal. Its rentals division manages more than 1,450 properties, determining market-related rentals, placing tenants quickly, applying strict tenant vetting and actively managing arrear rentals. It suits homeowners' associations, body corporates, landlords and tenants across Pretoria North, Pretoria East, Pretoria Central, Centurion and Midrand who need professional property or rental management.

Pretoria Food Club, based in Waverley, is a local club within South Africa's Food Club Hub network, which now counts 57 active clubs, more than 9,800 members and over 48,000 orders processed nationally. Members browse their club's online shop, place an order, and collect it on market day, so each delivery is built around a single, scheduled collection rather than ad hoc shopping.

The model lets the farmer set the price rather than a supermarket, cutting out hidden markups and middlemen, so members get fewer food miles, nutrient-dense food grown in living soil, and a direct line to the people growing it. The network describes its purpose as helping people know their farmer, feed their family and build their community. It suits Waverley households who want to buy fresh, locally grown produce directly from farmers on a regular, neighbourhood-based schedule.

Preweld (Pty) Ltd - Rosslyn is part of Preweld, a supplier of industrial and specialty gas, cutting and welding equipment trading since 1979. Its product range covers industrial gases, LPG gas refills, welding machines including MIG, TIG and ARC equipment, plasma cutters, welding consumables, filler material and abrasives, alongside services such as gas installation, cryogenic liquid products, and equipment repairs and maintenance.

The company also stocks a full range of personal protective equipment, including overalls, dust masks, safety specs, respirators, gloves, and safety shoes and boots, so customers can be equipped from top to toe. Preweld describes its staff as expertly trained to help customers find the right products for their specific needs, and it operates several branches across Gauteng to serve industrial and commercial businesses in different areas. It suits tradespeople and businesses in Rosslyn needing welding equipment, industrial gas or PPE from an established local supplier.

items.description:
Pure Water Components, based in Zwartkop, Centurion, specialises in clean water solutions and distributes high-quality, cost-effective water purification products to homes and industry. The company operates through well-established distribution networks and offers a comprehensive range of products, including aqua accessories, bag filters, brine tanks and accessories, carbon block filters, CNP vertical multistage pumps, disk filters, and domestic water purification systems and accessories.

Its online shop also lists standard and slimline blue plastic filter housings among its stocked parts, with distributor and trade pricing available for returning customers, wholesalers and distributors. The company says it aims to combine competitive prices with excellent customer service and support, and grows its reach by partnering with allied distribution companies. It suits homeowners and businesses in the Centurion area looking for water purification components, as well as trade customers wanting bulk or wholesale pricing.

Purplebell Events is a wedding and event planning business in Clubview, Centurion, where each client can customise their wedding or event, including custom floral and decor arrangements created with attention to detail. The business says every bride strives for their own sense of perfection, and its team works with each couple to create that picture together, with wedding flowers delicately placed as a key part of the process.

The business is run by someone with 19 years of experience as an architect specialising in retail and shopping centre work, coordinating between tenants and professionals on some of South Africa's major shopping centre developments, as well as interior design work for well-known franchises including African Bank and Nando's. That background in colour, proportion and composition carries through into the floral and decor side of the business. It suits couples in Centurion who want a personalised, design-led approach to their wedding décor and event planning.

Redheads Engineering Solutions, based in The Willows, Pretoria, is the South African arm of the Redheads Group, founded in Germany and now operating as a dynamic international provider of engineering services across industries such as energy, mining and manufacturing. Its services include specialist engineering, project management, field services, quality assurance, automation and process optimisation, delivered either as a full outsourcing partner or to manage large-scale projects.

The group also sources staff or provides contract staff on a temporary basis where clients need additional engineering capacity, alongside its own recruiting services for engineering roles. Its strapline, your vision, our expertise, one team, reflects its position as both a hands-on delivery partner and a flexible source of engineering personnel. It suits industrial, commercial, retail, institutional and government clients in South Africa who need engineering project work completed or skilled engineering staff placed.

Renovation and Demolition Home Services, trading as TNTE Renovations, is based in Equestria, Pretoria, and provides renovation solutions to both corporate and individual clients. The business describes its approach as total project commitment, drawing on an extensive network of qualified, highly skilled and experienced tradespeople who are confident and competent in the selection, operation, service and maintenance needed for each job.

The company showcases previous work and projects on its site, including client DIY videos, giving prospective customers a way to see finished renovation work before committing to a project. Its strapline, renovations you can count on, reflects its focus on reliability across each stage of a renovation. It suits homeowners and businesses in the Equestria area who want a renovation project handled by a team of vetted, experienced tradespeople rather than a single contractor.

Rent Me Self Storage is a custom-built self-storage facility in Doornpoort and Montana, Pretoria, offering four unit sizes to suit different needs. Its 2x3 unit, from R542 a month excluding VAT, suits files, boxes, appliances or small furniture, or a one-bedroom flat; its 3x3 unit, from R624, suits larger equipment, furniture and appliances or two to three small bedrooms; its 4x3 unit, from R770, suits a two- to three-bedroom home plus garage contents; and its 6x3 unit, from R890, suits the contents of a small three- to four-bedroom home or a single garage.

A once-off admin fee of R220 excluding VAT applies on booking, and prohibited items include hazardous chemicals, illegal substances or stolen goods, firearms, and food or perishable goods. The facility is open Monday to Saturday from 6:45am to 6:30pm and on Sundays and public holidays from 8am to 5pm, with office hours separately running Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturday from 8am to 1pm. It suits Pretoria residents and businesses who need secure, flexible self-storage on a month-to-month basis.

Retro Rabbit, based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, is a design and engineering consultancy that builds digital products, platforms and AI experiences. The company describes itself as design-first and technology-agnostic, combining user experience, software engineering, AI enablement and digital strategy to deliver solutions that are secure, scalable and easy to use, under the strapline brilliant design, built properly.

Its client list includes several of South Africa's major banks and insurers, among them ABSA Bank, Nedbank, FNB, Standard Bank and Capitec, along with Discovery, Mercantile Bank, Telesure, Makro, Dial Direct, First for Women and Momentum. The consultancy positions itself as handling the technical complexity of a digital product so that clients can focus on growth, innovation and customer outcomes. It suits organisations, particularly in banking, insurance and retail, that need a partner to design and build secure, scalable digital products rather than building in-house.

Rollco is a paper products manufacturer based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, producing thermal till rolls, bond till rolls, bank rolls, blank and printed labels, bulk labels, continuous paper, credit card machine rolls, EFT-POS rolls and fax rolls. The company says its products are made with high-quality materials for clear, consistent print quality and durability, which reduces paper jams and prolongs the life of client machines.

Rollco also prints till rolls and labels to a client's own specifications, offering a wide range of products to meet different business needs, and it says it keeps innovating to bring newer products to market. The company positions itself as a reliable alternative for businesses frustrated with unreliable paper suppliers, poor print quality or high costs. It is open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 4pm, and it suits retailers, banks and other businesses that need point-of-sale or banking paper products manufactured and supplied locally.

Romalepe Chartered Accountants Inc is a 100% black-owned, Level 1 BBBEE auditing and consulting firm based in Heatherdale, Pretoria, established in February 2019. The firm provides assurance, advisory and taxation services to a diverse range of businesses as well as the public sector, built on what it describes as a foundation of integrity and excellence.

The firm says it takes pride in being a Level 1 BBBEE contributor, committed to empowerment and to developing future black professionals in the profession. Its stated mission is to maintain professionalism across all its services so it can build long-term relationships with clients, keeping communication transparent and consistently flowing. The firm is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4pm, and it suits businesses and public-sector clients in Pretoria seeking audit, advisory or tax services from a transformation-focused accounting firm.

items.description:
Rosslyn Improvement Districts, known as RID, is an area-improvement organisation for the Rosslyn industrial zone, working in collaboration with the City of Tshwane to prioritise Rosslyn as a key industrial area. Its beautification work includes weekly grass-cutting and cleaning of roads and main entrances, along with initiatives such as cleaning your doorstep campaigns and the painting of robots, road signs and dustbins.

On safety and security, RID coordinates rapid response with the RID, Tshwane Metro Police, SAPS and private security firms, supported by daily TMPD motorbike patrols, protection of critical infrastructure such as substations, cables and pylons, a dedicated incident-reporting number for members through the RID Satellite Office, and 24-hour CCTV surveillance linked to a control room. On infrastructure, it establishes a structured approach to upgrading and maintaining roads, water and electrical systems, with technical task teams that include local businesses working alongside the city on critical upgrades. It suits businesses operating in Rosslyn who want a collective voice on security, cleanliness and infrastructure in their industrial area.

Route 20 One Pack & Pantry is a packaging wholesaler and distributor based in Silverton, Pretoria, supplying food packaging, plastic and paper bags, spices and sauces, and polystyrene products, alongside cleaning products, soap and degreasers, sanitisers and PPE, and garage rolls. Its food packaging range includes biodegradable options, positioned as an eco-friendly alternative to standard packaging.

The company promotes fast delivery and says it supplies both corporate companies and small businesses at reasonable prices, with collections available from its Silverton premises on weekdays between 10am and 1pm and again between 2pm and 4pm. It suits businesses in and around Pretoria that need packaging, pantry supplies or cleaning products and PPE delivered or collected from one wholesale distributor.

items.description:
Rx Health is a registered managed care organisation accredited with the Council of Medical Schemes, based at Alenti Office Park in The Willows, Pretoria, as part of the Rx Group of Companies. The company specialises in providing customised, integrated health risk and clinical management services to low-income medical schemes.

Its hospital benefit management service ensures that medical scheme rules, exclusions and related protocols and procedures are managed in a cost-effective manner, while its disease management programmes are structured to support members by improving the quality of care they receive. Its pharmaceutical benefit management service focuses on giving medical scheme members appropriate, cost-effective, quality treatment. It suits medical schemes, particularly those serving lower-income members, that need hospital, disease and pharmaceutical benefits managed by a specialist, accredited organisation.

SA College Private School (SACPS) is an independent, co-educational school in central Pretoria, within walking distance of the Union Buildings. The school's stated mission is to allow each learner to achieve the best they can through a holistic educational approach, aiming to grow every child to their maximum potential and to consistently achieve a 100% pass rate across the school.

Student life includes extramural activities and sport, robotics and coding, excursions and concerts, alongside academic results the school highlights among its top performers. Its strapline, together we can make a difference, reflects a stated commitment to fostering a supportive and inclusive environment where students, parents, teachers and staff work together, embracing diversity and open communication to empower students to reach their full potential. It suits Pretoria Central families looking for an independent school that combines academic results with a broad extramural and enrichment programme.

SA Tax Prac, based in East Lynne, Pretoria, provides taxation, administration and accounting services to both corporate and individual South African taxpayers. Its taxation work covers annual personal income tax submissions for individuals, professionals and sole traders, annual income tax submissions for companies and NPOs, and provisional tax calculation and submission, including the completion of the tax return itself.

The firm also assists with tax registrations, SARS disputes, payment arrangements and general SARS enquiries, alongside company registrations and deregistrations, annual return submissions, UBO submissions, cloud-based bookkeeping, payroll administration including monthly payslips, EMP201, PAYE and UIF, COIDA registrations, and VAT assistance. It suits individuals, sole traders, companies and non-profits in Pretoria who want their tax compliance and bookkeeping handled by one practice rather than juggling separate providers.

Sandown Commercial Vehicles Centurion, at Highway Business Park in Rooihuiskraal, sells new and used Mercedes-Benz and FUSO trucks, buses and vans. The dealership says great service goes beyond selling trucks, and it is trusted by businesses across South Africa because it takes the time to understand each client's needs and help them run a more efficient, profitable fleet.

Its after-sales support covers genuine parts, service contracts, fleet telematics and driver training, backed by tailored advice, proactive maintenance and 24/7 support aimed at keeping a client's business moving. The dealership's Bus Centre has recently secured back-to-back DTSA Dealer of the Year recognition. It suits transport operators and businesses in the Centurion area that need commercial trucks, buses or vans bought, serviced or supported under one roof.

Serendipity Toiletries, based in Silverton, Pretoria, is one of South Africa's leading cosmetic contract manufacturing and packing companies, focused on personal care, cosmetics, toiletries and fragrances. The company has no brands of its own, so it does not compete with its customers, and it offers a turnkey operation from concept to launch, covering formulation development for local and international markets, stability and micro testing, and sourcing new packaging locally and internationally.

Serendipity is the approved manufacturer for major retailers including Ackermans, Clicks, Mr Price, PEP, Pick n Pay and Woolworths, and it holds SMETA 2 Pillar and ISO 22716:2007 approval for its manufacturing standards. The company says its flexibility allows it to shorten lead times without compromising the exacting standards its retail clients set, while maintaining confidentiality for each brand it works with. It suits local and multinational companies that need bath, body, beauty, sunscreen or anti-ageing products developed and manufactured under contract.

SERR Synergy, based at Alenti Office Park in The Willows, Pretoria, was established in 2014 specifically to help businesses address the revised Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Codes of Good Practice alongside fundamental legal compliance requirements. Its services include B-BBEE consulting and compliance, skills development and employment equity facilitation, labour relations support, and occupational health and safety compliance.

The firm positions itself as a guide through South Africa's continuously changing business legislation, noting that new and amended laws create an integral web of compliance that can leave business owners feeling uncertain, on top of the other challenges they already face. It supports clients with newsletters, downloadable guidance and a blog archive that track changes in this legislation over time. It suits South African businesses that need ongoing support to stay compliant with B-BBEE, employment equity, labour relations and occupational health and safety requirements.

Shell Salvokop Service Station, on the corner of Potgieter Street and Skietpoort Avenue in Salvokop, is an unmanned, 24-hour fuel station offering Shell V-Power 95, Shell V-Power Diesel (50ppm), Shell Unleaded 93 and Shell Diesel Extra. The station accepts the Shell Card and other fuel cards, and includes a Shop - Select convenience store alongside an ATM and fast food counter for customers filling up.

Reviews of the station note friendly, helpful staff and a neat, well-kept store. Its round-the-clock fuel service means motorists can fill up and grab a quick bite or use the ATM at any hour. It suits motorists travelling through or near Salvokop, including those on Pretoria Main Road, who need gas, groceries or an ATM outside normal shopping hours.

Silverton Canopy Centre is a family-owned business established in 1989 and based in Silverton, Pretoria, supplying spares and accessories to the canopy, trailer, truck, tent and boat industry. Its product range includes fasteners, locks, hinges, straps, windows, fibreglass, resin, stays, pulleys, hooks, grommets, plugs and rubbers, among other components, sold through its dedicated spares division.

The business also specialises in repairing and customising trailers and canopies, drawing on its own canvas department and fibreglass division to handle jobs in-house rather than outsourcing them. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturday from 8am to 1pm, closed Sundays. It suits owners of canopies, trailers, trucks, tents or boats in Pretoria who need genuine parts or a repair and customisation job done by a long-established family business.

Smoof Move, based in Shere at Silver Lakes Golf Estate, Centurion, handles residential and office removals in Pretoria and the surrounding area, along with storage solutions and a quick clean-up service after a move. The company says it will beat any written quotation, positioning itself as a cost-effective option among Pretoria moving companies, and it also arranges weekly shared-load transport linking Pretoria, Johannesburg, Bloemfontein, Durban, Cape Town and Port Elizabeth.

Office removals are handled for businesses moving to larger premises anywhere in Gauteng, and the company says customer service comes first, with highly trained staff and good business ethics guiding each job. Its strapline plays on its own name, describing the aim as making every move a smooth move. It suits households and businesses in and around Pretoria that need a full-service, competitively priced removal, including interprovincial transport.

SOAR Centre, based in Raslouw, Centurion, specialises in empowering leaders and teams to reach their full potential for sustained organisational excellence, even during challenging times. Its consulting services focus on well-being, encouragement and leadership development, delivered through consulting, facilitation, training and research.

The centre partners with clients across a wide range of industries, including mining, telecommunications, finance, retail, petrochemicals, NGOs, government, defence, healthcare and manufacturing, both locally and internationally. What sets it apart is a team of multidisciplinary experts supported by a global network of associates with diverse ethnic and gender representation, bringing more than three decades of combined experience to its work with individuals, organisations and communities in South Africa and around the world. It suits organisations that want leadership development and well-being support built around sustained, long-term performance rather than a one-off training session.

SSS Steel Structures & Construction, based in Klerksoord, Pretoria North, fabricates and erects steel structures and steel frame buildings throughout Southern Africa. The family-owned business specialises in small, medium and large steel structures including churches, warehouses, worksheds, workshops and factories, along with aircraft and helicopter hangars.

The company offers a free, no-obligation quotation for every enquiry, and says it promises never to bill more than the amount quoted. Its stated aim is building excellence with steel structures in Gauteng, describing its work as redefining what is possible through steel fabrication and construction that delivers innovation and durability on every project. It suits churches, businesses and property owners across Southern Africa who need a steel structure fabricated and erected to South African building regulations, with price certainty agreed upfront.

SSW Construction is a family-owned steel fabrication and construction company based in Klerksoord, Akasia, with more than 12 years of experience. It specialises in steel roof trusses and roof sheeting, along with industrial structures such as factories and warehouses, and specialised buildings including hangars, churches, workshops and tool sheds.

The company says it has completed more than 33 projects successfully, built up more than 28 positive reviews and served more than 31 happy clients, with its work distinguished by a commitment to excellence and client satisfaction. Its roofing service covers designing and fabricating strong, reliable steel roof trusses for various buildings, while its factory work includes building state-of-the-art industrial structures.
